content.prompt: Write $f\times x$ at the top of each column (or at the end of each row in part c), find the sum, then calculate the mean.

spec.answerVisibility: The coloured multiplications and circled products are omitted from this student figure. The black 5+18+14+... and All Dots hints remain visible. No response is inserted into a box.

answer.worked:
The products above the occupied columns are $5,18,14,27,50,55,36$.
$$\begin{aligned}\text{Sum of data values}&=5+18+14+27+50+55+36\\\text{Sum of data values}&=205\\\text{Number of data values}&=1+3+2+3+5+5+3\\\text{Number of data values}&=22\\\bar{x}&=\frac{205}{22}\\\bar{x}&\approx9.3\quad\text{(1 d.p.)}\end{aligned}$$

answer.worked:
Products for scores 1 to 10: $5,4,15,32,25,54,21,24,72,40$.
$$\begin{aligned}\text{Sum of data values}&=5+4+15+32+25\\&\quad+54+21+24+72+40\\\text{Sum of data values}&=292\\\text{Number of data values}&=5+2+5+8+5+9+3+3+8+4\\\text{Number of data values}&=52\\\bar{x}&=\frac{292}{52}\\\bar{x}&\approx5.6\quad\text{(1 d.p.)}\end{aligned}$$

spec.answerVisibility: All six product boxes remain empty.

answer.worked:
From top to bottom, the products are $13\times1=13$, $4\times2=8$, $9\times3=27$, $10\times4=40$, $6\times5=30$ and $5\times6=30$.
$$\begin{aligned}\text{Sum of data values}&=13+8+27+40+30+30\\\text{Sum of data values}&=148\\\text{Number of data values}&=13+4+9+10+6+5\\\text{Number of data values}&=47\\\bar{x}&=\frac{148}{47}\\\bar{x}&\approx3.1\quad\text{(1 d.p.)}\end{aligned}$$
